delete-confirm-desc: They are removed from the local board. Syncing from Feishu won’t bring them back.
more-in-grid: {{count}} more — use the grid to see all
ai-prompt-records: Analyze these {{count}} {{dataset}} records from the local GEO database ({{db}}, table {{table}}, project {{project}}):
ai-prompt-view: Using the local GEO database ({{db}}, table {{table}}), analyze the current {{dataset}} view: project {{project}}, filters {{filters}}, {{count}} records.
empty-data-desc: Pull capture answers, sources, and probes from Feishu into the local database.
grade-c: Brand claims — write as “the brand says”
grade-e: Social posts — question ideas only, never facts
kb-rules-desc: One fact per entry, always with a source, facts kept apart from claims and sales talk, compliance checked. Nothing goes into content unless it’s in the knowledge base.
kb-sources-desc: PDF, Word, Excel, and images from the brand. Copies are kept unchanged in 原始资料 as the source of truth.
kb-sources-empty: No materials yet. Add the brand’s manuals, labels, reports, or FAQs to start.
kb-modules-desc: {{filled}} of {{total}} modules filled · {{facts}} entries in the ledger
kb-no-folder-title: This brand has no Space folder yet
kb-no-folder-desc: Open this brand’s Space once so its GEO folders, including the knowledge base, are created.
open-failed: Couldn't open it. Try the Files tab.
sources-import-failed: Couldn't add the files. Try again.
sync-not-configured: This Space has no Feishu source yet. Add GEO/feishu_sources.json to the Space folder.
space-not-ready-desc: Each Space is one brand project. Its GEO folder and database are created the first time the Space opens.
agent-prompt-analysis: Diagnose the captured answers of {{project}} in {{round}}. Database: {{db}}. For every answer in geo_answer that has no row in geo_answer_analysis yet (join on capture_code and capture_round), read the full answer and fill: mentions_own, mentioned_brands, brand_count, top_brand, own_in_top3, recommend_own, recommend_reason, reason_selling_points, not_recommend_reason, competitor_relation, sentiment, risk_tags. Use the brand facts in {{geo}}/01_品牌知识库 to recognise the brand and its selling points. Then write a short diagnosis of this round (where the brand is missing, which competitors lead and why) to {{geo}}/04_诊断分析/.
agent-prompt-probes: Help me draft intent probes for {{project}}. Direction: (describe what you want to test). Read the brand knowledge base in {{geo}}/01_品牌知识库 for categories, selling points, competitors, and entry points, then propose questions real users would ask an AI assistant. Show them to me first; after I confirm, insert them into table geo_probe in {{db}} (code, text, cep, framework, direction, brand_pointer, selling_points, review_status).
agent-prompt-citations: Analyse the sources AI platforms cited for {{project}} in {{round}} (table geo_citation in {{db}}). Rank sites and domains by how often they are cited, per AI platform and source type, point out which of our published pieces (geo_content URLs) are cited, and recommend where to publish next. Save the analysis to {{geo}}/05_引用来源/.
agent-prompt-drafts: Write GEO content for {{project}}. Start from the gaps in the latest diagnosis ({{geo}}/04_诊断分析 and table geo_answer_analysis in {{db}}) and the recommended channels in {{geo}}/05_引用来源. State only facts that exist in {{geo}}/01_品牌知识库 and follow 06_合规红线. Save each draft with several title variants to {{geo}}/06_内容生产/ and add a row per piece to geo_content with status 草稿.
agent-prompt-tracking: Write a progress report for {{project}}: compare the capture rounds in {{db}} (geo_capture_round, geo_answer, geo_answer_analysis, geo_citation), say what changed since the baseline, which published pieces (geo_content) AI now cites, and what to optimize next. Save it to {{geo}}/08_效果追踪/.
cmp-empty: No capture rounds yet. Add one under AI capture → Capture rounds.
import-feishu-desc: Copy history from a Feishu Base into the {{space}} Space. Configure the Base in GEO/feishu_sources.json inside the Space folder.
agents-load-failed: Could not load the agents. Check that the backend is running.
agents-root-desc: The only agent you talk to. It works out which stage of the pipeline a task belongs to, does it or hands it to that stage's agent, checks the result, writes it back to the Space, and reports.
agents-stages-desc: One per stage. The GEO Agent hands each one the batch work of its stage and checks what it returns.
